baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic identification in 80:42 couples the word-3 class noun with the word-4 description rather than leaving two unrelated insults.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concealment or rejection is the inward operation; departure from right and rupture of restraint is its outward operation. The second label therefore exposes what the first label does when it becomes conduct.

activation_trace.role: Concealing or rejecting truth supplies the hidden refusal named by the first label.
Departure from right and breach of restraint supplies the refusal's outward, boundary-breaking form.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives two cumulative moral labels: unbelievers and wicked people.
changed_reading.after: The verse identifies one coupled mechanism: truth is first covered, then the restraint organized by that truth is breached.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired predicates at words 3-4 permit the first root's favor and disavowal branches to interact with the second root's violated-restraint branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: A received good is covered rather than acknowledged; that non-acknowledgment becomes disavowal of relation and then violation of its due limits. This is a social and reciprocal reading of the pair, not only a propositional one.

activation_trace.role: Covering over a favor supplies failed acknowledgment as the first stage of the mechanism.
Disavowal supplies the relational severance produced by refusing acknowledgment.
Breach of restraint turns severed reciprocity into transgressive action.
The branch named from violated sanctity sharpens the breach as an infringement of protected relation.

changed_reading.before: The labels classify private belief and generic bad conduct.
changed_reading.after: The labels can classify broken reciprocity: a benefit is denied, the relation is disowned, and its protected limits are crossed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3 and 4 place a root of covering directly before a root of splitting, outflow, and dawn-breaking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair forms a threshold sequence: something is put under cover and then something breaks outward. Focus-only evidence does not yet determine whether this is concealment followed by destructive rupture or a neutral material cycle whose moral direction depends on its object.

activation_trace.role: Concrete covering supplies the closing side of the paired threshold.
Covering seed gives the closing operation a potentially generative material form.
Wide splitting and outflow supply the opening side of the threshold.
Dawn breaking from night preserves a potentially illuminating, rather than intrinsically vicious, opening image.

changed_reading.before: The two words are fixed moral essences with no internal material relation.
changed_reading.after: The pair can first be heard as coupled threshold operations, cover then opening, whose blame will depend on what is concealed and what boundary is ruptured.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening scene stages occlusion as an allocation of attention: a face contracts, attention turns away, the physically blind seeker approaches purposefully, and attention is occupied elsewhere. This revises the final pair into a process in which latent receptivity is covered by surface judgment and the duty of attention is then breached.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the attentional occlusion that hides receptivity.
Breach of restraint supplies the broken duty that follows mis-seeing.
Facial contraction makes an inward evaluation surface as a visible closure.
Turning away gives the closure a directional act and a lost relation.
The inner-blindness branch reverses the scene's visible disability into a possible failure of discernment elsewhere.
Purposeful movement marks the overlooked person as actively oriented toward a desired good.
Being occupied by one thing away from another completes the mechanism of selective concealment.

structural_cues: 80:1-10 alternates approach and turning, so attention itself behaves like a gate that can expose or cover a person's receptivity.
The scene supplies a diagnostic analogy for 80:42; it does not identify the corrected addressee as a member of the final class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facial closure, turning, physical blindness, purposeful approach, and distraction. I infer an arrow from selective attention to concealed receptivity and then breached duty; a live alternative is that the opening correction and final classification remain separate episodes.

changed_reading.before: The pair names an already fixed abstract type.
changed_reading.after: The pair also diagnoses how such a type is enacted: attention covers a real possibility in another person, then crosses the duty owed to that possibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder restores what could be absent, the sheet preserves it, the transmitting root activates uncovering, and truth passes into action. Against that chain, the focus pair reads as an exact reversal: covering blocks disclosure, while breach severs received truth from enacted truth.

activation_trace.role: Concealing truth reverses the disclosure chain built by the preceding textual images.
Departure from right names the break between preserved instruction and performed conduct.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies recovery from concealment or absence.
The written sheet gives disclosed truth a durable material carrier.
Removing a covering makes transmission itself an anti-concealment operation.
Truth that carries through speech and action supplies the intact alternative to rupture.

structural_cues: 80:11-16 moves from reminder to written carrier to hands and truthful agents, forming an unbroken custody chain.
The focus pair closes the surah after that chain has been tested in creation, provision, and judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembering, writing, uncovering, and truth enacted. I infer that concealment blocks this chain and breach disconnects reception from performance; the alternative is that these are parallel descriptions of revelation and character without a causal link.

changed_reading.before: The first label means rejection and the second independently means misconduct.
changed_reading.after: The pair is an anti-transmission sequence: disclosure is covered at reception, then the integrity between message and action is broken.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same concealment root is exclaimed over before a sequence of originating, commanding, watering, opening earth, producing seed, and granting benefit. The final pair thus condenses failed reciprocity: the source of benefit is covered, its due is left unperformed, and ordered opening is converted into moral breach.

activation_trace.role: Covering a favor supplies non-acknowledgment as the failure governing the provision sequence.
Breach of restraint supplies the wrong-directed response to measured and useful opening.
The earlier recurrence directly foregrounds ingratitude before the gifts are enumerated.
Origination supplies the first benefit whose source can be acknowledged or covered.
Performing and discharging a due supplies the reciprocity explicitly left incomplete.
Binding direction supplies the limit that moral rupture crosses.
Pouring supplies abundant downward input to the productive cycle.
The earth's ordered opening distinguishes fruitful splitting from culpable breach.
Seed that grows supplies the concealed potential brought forth by ordered opening.
Enjoyed benefit states the cycle's recipient-facing function.
The latent favor branch beneath the livestock term broadens provision into benefaction.

structural_cues: 80:17 introduces the concealment root, 80:18-23 moves through origin and unperformed command, and 80:24-32 displays provision in detail.
The productive split at 80:26 shows that opening is not itself blameworthy; object, measure, and outcome determine its value.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a root recurrence, an unperformed due, and a full provision cycle. I infer that benefit generates an acknowledgment obligation and that productive opening contrasts with moral breach; the alternative is that the final labels summarize a broader class without specifically encoding reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: The verse closes with general unbelief and wickedness.
changed_reading.after: It closes the gift cycle with a precise failed response: origin and provision are covered over, their due remains undischarged, and a created capacity to open becomes boundary violation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Burial hides and lowers, then revival opens and spreads. This ordered closure-reopening sequence revises the focus roots away from an equation of covering with evil and splitting with evil: the final pair names misdirected threshold acts, covering what should be manifest and rupturing what should remain protected.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies one side of the threshold, now qualified by a legitimate burial cover.
Splitting and outflow supply reopening, now distinguished from transgressive rupture.
Breach of restraint marks the morally wrong species of opening.
Concealment in burial supplies a bounded, timed, and legitimate closure.
Opening and spreading supply the reversal of burial's closure.
Revival after death makes reopening temporal and agent-governed rather than random rupture.

structural_cues: The repeated temporal connectors in 80:21-22 order closure before reopening and assign each operation its proper time.
The focus pair preserves the same material polarity but changes its ethical direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burial followed by divinely timed opening and revival. I infer that the sequence calibrates the focus pair by object and timing; the live alternative is that burial and revival are only eschatological context with no lexical calibration of 80:42.

changed_reading.before: Covering and splitting are inherently negative images in the final labels.
changed_reading.after: The sequence distinguishes rightful thresholds from culpable ones: these people cover what calls for disclosure and break what calls for restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flight strips away progressively intimate bonds until each person is enclosed by an affair that suffices to occupy them. This activates disavowal inside the first focus root and boundary violation inside the second: the final class can be heard socially as relation-denying and self-enclosed, while the scene also warns that the flight itself is universal rather than a simple cause of the label.

activation_trace.role: Disavowal supplies the final label's relational rather than solely doctrinal register.
Breach of restraint supplies the violated obligations exposed when bonds no longer protect.
Flight supplies active withdrawal from relation.
Brotherhood supplies the first explicit bond from which withdrawal occurs.
Close companionship supplies a chosen and sustained bond that also fails to hold.
Each person's absorbing affair supplies the enclosure that replaces shared concern.
Sufficiency makes the private affair functionally exclude every competing relation.

structural_cues: The branchless ص خ خ cue at 80:33 is used only as the abrupt structural boundary before relational flight; no inventory identifiers are inferred for it.
80:34-36 expands from brother through parents, spouse, and children before 80:37 contracts the field to each isolated person and affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flight from bonds and an individually sufficient affair. I infer that this exposes the social shape of disavowal and breach; a materially live alternative is that universal crisis, not prior relational vice, causes the separation.

changed_reading.before: The labels concern belief and conduct inside an isolated individual.
changed_reading.after: The labels can also expose a relational structure: disavowal withdraws from bonds, breach violates their dues, and judgment reveals the resulting self-enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final contrast externalizes two threshold outcomes on faces. One cohort is uncovered, bright, opened by joy; the other is overlaid by dust and overtaken by constriction. The focus demonstrative then identifies the second cohort: concealment has become visible cover, while the dawn potential of the second root is inverted into breach without light.

activation_trace.role: Covering becomes the visible overlay on the second set of faces.
Hidden rejection supplies the inward condition that the facial cover can expose rather than conceal.
Dawn-breaking supplies a bright opening that is conspicuously realized by the contrasting faces, not this named cohort.
Breach of restraint resolves the second root's negative use when its dawn image fails.
Light disclosed in a face supplies the successful dawn-like alternative.
The face standing for the self makes moral state publicly legible.
The face opening to reveal the teeth supplies bodily disclosure rather than cover.
Joyful news opening the skin supplies an inside-to-surface release.
Dust-colored overlay supplies the literal surface cover on the contrasting faces.
Overtaking and overpowering makes the cover an active domination rather than passive color.
Constriction supplies the closing pressure opposite the first cohort's opening.

structural_cues: The contrastive introduction of another set of faces at 80:40 and the demonstrative at 80:42 make the second visual trajectory the immediate antecedent of the labels.
The sequence moves from surface overlay to overpowering constriction and then names the people, turning hidden classification into visible outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unveiled light, bodily opening, dusty overlay, overpowering cover, constriction, and the final demonstrative. I infer that the labels diagnose the mechanism visible on the second faces; the alternative is a simple visual prelude followed by conventional class names without lexical interaction.

changed_reading.before: The verse supplies abstract names after unrelated facial descriptions.
changed_reading.after: The names resolve the facial contrast: concealed truth returns as an exposed covering, and a root capable of dawn is realized as breach without illumination, a failed opening under pressure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus forms are condemnatory while the cited focus branches describe farming and material opening. It remains anchored because the context explicitly pours water, splits earth, and brings seed into growth. Render it only as an anti-harvest analogy or latent counter-image, not as a claim that the labels literally mean farmers or cultivators.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-3 root can name covering seed and the word-4 root can name splitting with outflow, forming the same two operations displayed in 80:25-27.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed supplies the first operation of a cultivation cycle.
Wide splitting and outflow supply the cycle's emergence operation.
Poured input supplies the water that activates the covered potential.
Earth opening repeats the focus pair's second material operation.
Growing seed supplies the fruit-bearing outcome expected from cover and opening.

changed_reading.before: The pair is only a doubled condemnation.
changed_reading.after: The pair shadows a cultivation sequence but as an arrested or inverted harvest: its bearers enact cover and rupture while failing to yield acknowledgment as fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus adjective uses the moral breach branch, not an ordinary dawn description. It remains valuable because the exact root carries dawn-breaking and the immediately preceding face contrast is organized by disclosed light versus dark overlay. Downstream prose should call it a failed- or counterfeit-dawn counter-image, never a lexical translation of the focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-4 root contains a dawn-breaking branch, yet the demonstratively identified cohort follows faces overtaken by cover rather than faces disclosing light.

activation_trace.role: Enveloping darkness supplies the cover under which the expected dawn fails.
Dawn breaking from night supplies the unrealized positive possibility inside the second root.
Facial light assigns genuine dawn-like disclosure to the contrasting cohort.
Visible sparkling supplies another realized image of brightness.
A dark calamity with lingering effect supplies the anti-dawn condition of the named cohort.
Constriction closes the surface that a true dawn would open.

changed_reading.before: The second label has no relation to the preceding light-dark contrast.
changed_reading.after: The label can cast its bearers as a counterfeit dawn: they break restraint rather than break darkness, so their opening yields no light and is overtaken by cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses non-dominant semantic branches of the two focus roots, so it is unsuitable as a gloss or primary interpretation. It remains anchored because both reparative covering and overflowing good are packet-attested focus branches, and the context repeatedly activates purification, benefit, and expansive obedience. Preserve it only as a counterfactual capacity whose inversion sharpens the condemnation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-3 inventory includes covering that effaces wrongdoing, and the word-4 inventory includes overflowing generosity, giving the condemnatory pair latent capacities opposite its realized direction.

activation_trace.role: Covering that effaces wrongdoing supplies a reparative alternative to covering truth or favor.
Overflowing generosity supplies a beneficial alternative to uncontrolled moral rupture.
Purification supplies the reparative outcome that covering could have served.
Benefit supplies the outward criterion separating good overflow from harmful breach.
Expansive goodness and obedience supply a realized model of abundance kept within right direction.

changed_reading.before: The roots merely encode fixed evil qualities.
changed_reading.after: The condemnation can be sharpened as inverted capacity: covering that could efface wrong instead hides truth, and overflow that could give good instead breaks restraint.

strongest_changes: The pair shifted from two independent labels to a causal mechanism: concealment at reception becomes breach in action.
The creation and provision sequence made ingratitude and unperformed due more specific than generic unbelief and wickedness.
Burial, earth-opening, and growth showed that cover and rupture are ethically calibrated by object, timing, and outcome rather than being intrinsically negative.
The final faces made concealment visible as overlay and turned the dawn branch of the second root into a failed-opening contrast.
summary.what_was_special: The exact focus pair contains a cover/open polarity that the context repeatedly restages as attention and neglect, reminder and disclosure, seed and opened earth, grave and reopening, severed bonds, and bright versus overlaid faces. Those repetitions support several coexisting readings without collapsing them into one gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus grammar supports coupling but does not decide whether concealment causes breach or whether the labels are simply cumulative.
The farmer, dawn, reparative-covering, and generous-overflow branches are live counter-images, but their distance from the focus forms limits confidence.
The demonstrative strongly follows the darkened faces, yet the packet alone does not prove that facial cover is caused by, rather than merely associated with, the named qualities.
The universal flight from kin can expose disavowal structurally without proving that relational failure is the reason for the final classification.
